description: Label what kind of operator a seller is — amazon, brand-direct, likely-authorized-retailer, arbitrage, or reseller — from our cross-brand operator signals (how many brands they span, their fulfilment mix, their primary brand). Use when the user asks 'what kind of seller is this', 'is this an authorized retailer or an arbitrage seller', 'classify this operator'. Heuristic label, not a legal determination. Amazon US/UK.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR. Amazon only.

name: operator_classifier
